detail: Full summary: migrate --reverse prints 'previous config backed up to config.yml.pre-migrate.bak' even when the first-wins rule correctly skips the write because the backup already exists — cosmetic misreport, same class as issue #39 preview counts. Worth folding into #39 or a small v2.1 issue.
